High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioners have filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India making a prayer that respondents authorities be directed to make payment of interest in accordance with Section 80 of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Government Advocate appearing for State prays for short time to seek instruction whether any deposit has been made to Collector by P.W.D. or not.
Meanwhile, notices be issued to respondents by both modes on payment of P.F. within seven days.
List the matter after four weeks.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
